2607.07669.title: DiaLLM: An Investigation into the Robustness-Generation Gap in English Dialect Adaptation
2607.07669.paper_summary: Large language models increasingly \emph{understand} dialectal English, yet still \emph{produce} only standard, US-leaning English, leaving dialectal generation, the harder half of the problem, largely unaddressed. We introduce \textbf{DiaLLM}, which continually pretrains three open-weight language model families on the International Corpus of English and applies implicit and explicit post-training paradigms, each combined with three model alignment strategies, giving the first controlled comparison of these components across Australian, Indian, and Northern British English. Our results reveal that dialectal robustness and generation are \emph{dissociated}: benchmarks are shaped by continual pretraining and SFT, while alignment visibly reshapes generation in ways benchmarks do not capture. Explicit variety-targeted adaptation produces output reliably recognised as dialectal and preferred over broad alignment, yet the method that most aggressively optimises the dialectal reward is not preferred by human evaluators. Independent linguistic analysis corroborates this reward-quality gap, most clearly on two of the three families. No single alignment method dominates, and closing the gap will require richer reward designs and continued investment in dialectal resources. We release all code, checkpoints, and preference datasets.
2607.07669.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越能夠\emph{理解}方言英語，但仍然\emph{產出}僅限於標準的、美國傾向的英語，讓方言生成這個問題的較難部分大多未得到解決。我們介紹\textbf{DiaLLM}，它持續對三個開放權重的語言模型家族進行預訓練，使用國際英語語料庫，並應用隱性和顯性的後訓練範式，每種範式結合三種模型對齊策略，首次在澳大利亞、印度和北英國英語之間進行這些組件的受控比較。我們的結果顯示，方言的穩健性和生成是\emph{脫離}的：基準是由持續預訓練和SFT塑造的，而對齊則以明顯的方式重塑生成，這些方式基準無法捕捉。顯式的針對變體的適應產生的輸出被可靠地識別為方言，並且比廣泛對齊更受偏好，然而最積極優化方言獎勵的方法並不被人類評估者所偏好。獨立的語言學分析證實了這一獎勵與質量之間的差距，尤其在三個家族中的兩個上最為明顯。沒有單一的對齊方法佔主導地位，縮小這一差距將需要更豐富的獎勵設計和對方言資源的持續投資。我們釋放所有代碼、檢查點和偏好數據集。
